title: Extensive simulations for longest common subsequences: Finite size scaling, a cavity solution, and configuration space properties
key_contribution: Introduces Bernoulli matching model with cavity solution; finds finite-size scaling law; discovers exponentially many optimal alignments

title: Mean-field approximations to the longest common subsequence problem
key_contribution: Systematic refinement of cavity approximation by incorporating correlations; finds non-perturbative long-range correlation effects

title: Thermodynamical Approach to the Longest Common Subsequence Problem
key_contribution: Develops thermodynamic (temperature-dependent) framework for LCS; proves convergence of particle speed and density
